about: DynamicPromptWizard is an advanced platform that processes client requests using a multi-agent LLM workflow. It automatically categorizes requests, gathers required information, evaluates missing details, and routes tasks to specialized contractors.

tools.name: FastAPI
tools.description: High-performance Python web framework used for the core backend routing and APIs.

tools.name: LangGraph
tools.description: Framework for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs. Powers the core workflow engine.

tools.name: React & Vite
tools.description: Modern frontend stack used for building the user interface and this visual Code Atlas.

tools.name: MS SQL Server
tools.description: Relational database used for storing clients, projects, categories, contractors, and conversation states.

stackTrace.name: POST /chat
stackTrace.description: The main API entry point. Receives the user message, initializes or loads the AgentState from the database, and passes it to the Engine.

stackTrace.name: Engine.process()
stackTrace.description: Compiles the LangGraph workflow and invokes the state graph, starting the multi-agent execution.

stackTrace.name: data_validator_node
stackTrace.description: Validates if the user input contains enough meaningful information to proceed or if it's too vague.

stackTrace.name: categorizer_node
stackTrace.description: Categorizes the user's request into predefined categories (e.g., Plumbing, Electrical, General).

stackTrace.name: information_gatherer_node
stackTrace.description: If information is missing, this node formulates questions to ask the user to clarify the request.

stackTrace.name: contractor_categorizer_node
stackTrace.description: Breaks down a complex project into sub-tasks assigning a specific contractor type to each.

stackTrace.name: multi_task_architect_node
stackTrace.description: For complex projects involving multiple contractors, this node architects the overall solution and explains it to the client.

stackTrace.name: intake_node
stackTrace.description: Gathers necessary client intake info (Name, Phone, Address) before creating official tenders.

stackTrace.name: tender_creator_node
stackTrace.description: Final node. Generates the official tender documents and saves them to the database, concluding the workflow.
